-Ov78frpI1lOoZwSELD3.description: Albrigtsen was born in the northern city of Tromsø, Norway ( 1985) and began playing drums at the age of 6 before switching to the guitar. Odd Steinar Albrigtsen started to study jazz at the conservatory in Trondheim, Norway. He then lived in Oslo and played with the great musicians on the Scandinavian jazz scene and after that he went to study at Aaron Copland School of Music in New York where he studied with great american jazz musicians such as Michael Mossman, David Berkman Paul Bollenbeck and Lage Lund.

-P10jsbyQghzOLBOIgS_.description: On January 24th, he will perform his compositions at Donau115 for the first time. His repertoire includes pieces from his EP Negative Space—a concept album exploring liminal spaces and uncanny architecture—as well as his more recent release, Nervous System, an EP centered on anxiety, with each track delving into a different facet of this fundamental human emotion. His music evokes vivid, cinematic imagery while showcasing the impressive sonic range of the nylon-string guitar.

-P2RcPWXTEcXoiq4vJDv.description: Following the release of his debut album Love Myself on Swiss label Mouthwatering Records, Tal is touring Europe with a show that moves seamlessly between delicate solo moments and rich, expansive arrangements. -P4TvAPyEPOrmFss1zrI.description: In 2014 and 2015 he was finalist of the New German Jazz Award. Matthias was a member of the Wolfgang Muthspiel Trio for 8 years, and played with many more internationally renowned musicians. Concerts with these artists brought him to over 30 countries all over the world. After moving to New York City, where he was living from 2017 to 2020, Matthias moved back to Berlin, where he is now part of various formations with a broad range of musical styles. Recently he started teaching at the wounderful JIMI/Tiroler Landeskonservatorium/Mozarteum Innsbruck.
